description: An RFID/NFC reader (13.56 MHz, MIFARE cards) with an SPI interface.
how_to_use: 3.3V/GND power, MOSI/MISO/SCK are real SPI — wire to the board's real SPI pins, shares those lines with any other SPI device on the same bus. RST (reset) and IRQ (interrupt) are usually left unconnected. IMPORTANT: this part's pin literally named 'SDA' is actually the SPI chip-select, NOT I2C data, despite the name — deliberately left OUT of protocol_legs here (the SDA/SCL protection is I2C-specific; treating this SDA as an I2C signal would be wrong and could falsely trigger I2C-bus protection on an unrelated board pin). Give it its own unique CS pin like any other SPI device.
